issues.title: Implement login form
issues.body: Build the login form with username and password fields so customers can sign in from the portal landing page.
acceptance_criteria: A logged-out visitor sees the login form on the landing page
Submitting valid credentials signs the user in
Submitting invalid credentials shows an inline error

issues.title: Add session handling
issues.body: Persist the authenticated session so the user stays signed in across page loads until they log out.
acceptance_criteria: The session survives a page reload
